evidence: rowan-api: v1 is accountless — identity is a client-minted pseudonymous UUID sent as the X-Device-Id header (Keychain on native, localStorage in the web build).
rowan-api schema: the account_id column exists but is NULL on every v1 row; it is reserved for a future Apple-sync release.
rowan-app/index-onboarding.html ships no sign-up, sign-in, or password surface.

rowan-api/app/observability.py: no ad or analytics SDKs; no PostHog. Sentry initialises only when SENTRY_DSN is set, with send_default_pii=False and a scrubber dropping request bodies and auth headers.
docs/PLAN.md §6 telemetry decision: crash reporting only, with health-content-free breadcrumbs.
Safety events are content-free: SHA-256 hashed device id, tier, route, and a bounded reason code — never message text, symptom, or condition.
docs/PLAN.md §6: 'No ad/analytics SDKs touching health data; never sell/share it.'
No advertising SDK is present in rowan-app or rowan-api.
